svg.aria-label: The guard, line by line. A pattern lists the names the AI must not touch: the posting helper, the posting configuration, the sign-in cache and the harness profile. A guard is synchronous and final, so no other plugin can turn its refusal back into a yes. It looks at the arguments of every tool call, shell commands and file reads included. The AI sees the reason and treats it as a deliberate block.
svg.text: From bc-posting/index.js. A deny-list, so it raises the bar and does not build a wall
